summary: Boyd Group Services filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim MD&A, interim condensed consolidated financial statements, CEO/CFO certifications, and a November 11, 2026 press release for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings filing, the US/Canadian equivalent of a domestic quarterly earnings report on Form 10-Q; it incorporates disclosure into the registrant's Form F-10 and S-8 registration statements. No transaction, consideration, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. What to watch: operating metrics—same-store sales, collision repair volumes, labor and wage trends, acquisition-driven location growth (1,336 Canadian and 1,203 US collision locations)—rather than any arbitrage angle.
